src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.964493327fda7e4b:
**BMW 116d u našem servisu u Beogradu.**

Ovog puta nam je stigao BMW 116d, kojem je bila potrebna sveobuhvatna tehnička provera i otklanjanje nekoliko kvarova. Kod BMW-a je važno razumeti karakteristike motora i pažljivo posmatrati svaku komponentu: ne menjamo samo delove, već istražujemo uzrok zbog kojeg dolaze do kvara.

**Koje radove smo izvršili na BMW 116d?**

1. **Zamena antifriza.** Izvršili smo zamenu rashladne tečnosti kako bismo obezbedili pravilan rad sistema hlađenja motora. Pravovremena zamena antifriza pomaže u zaštiti elemenata sistema od korozije, održava optimalnu temperaturu i prevencija pregrevanja motora.
2. **Podmazivanje EGR ventila u ispušnom sistemu.** Obavili smo servis podupornog ventila sistema recirkulacije ispušnih gasova, koji se nalazi u ispušnoj cevi. Ovaj deo učestvuje u regulaciji pritiska ispušnih gasova i radu EGR sistema na dizel motorima BMW. Vremenom se mehanizam može zaprljati, zapečati i raditi neispravno. Izvršili smo neophodno podmazivanje mehanizma ventila.
3. **Zamena nosača motora.** Zamenili smo istrošeni nosač motora BMW 116d. Nosači motora su odgovorni za učvršćenje pogonskog skupa i smanjenje prenosa vibracija na karoseriju vozila. Njihovo istrošenje može dovesti do pojačanih vibracija, neprijatnih osećaja u kabini i dodatnog opterećenja na druge komponente.
4. **Utvrđena potreba za zamenom dempfera obrtnog momenta.** Tokom servisa smo takođe ustanovili da će automobilu biti potrebna dalja zamena dempfera obrtnog momenta radilice. Ovaj deo pomaže u prigušivanju oscilacija i obezbeđuje stabilan rad remenice dodatne opreme. Odlaganje zamene istrošenog dempfera se ne preporučuje, jer njegovo oštećenje može dovesti do dodatnih kvarova i skupih popravki.
src/content/works/BMW 116D/index.md.f2dc489ea00d07c0:
**BMW 116d at our car service in Belgrade.**

This time, we had a BMW 116d come in for comprehensive maintenance and to address several issues. It’s crucial to understand the specifics of the engines in BMWs and to examine every detail carefully. We don’t just replace parts; we identify the underlying causes of their failure.

**What work did we perform on the BMW 116d?**

1. **Coolant replacement.** We replaced the coolant to ensure the proper functioning of the engine's cooling system. Timely coolant replacement helps protect system components from corrosion, maintain optimal temperature levels, and prevent engine overheating.
2. **Lubrication of the EGR pressure valve in the exhaust system.** We serviced the EGR pressure valve located in the exhaust pipe. This component plays a role in regulating back pressure of exhaust gases and the functioning of the EGR system on BMW diesel engines. Over time, the mechanism can become dirty, seize up, and function improperly. We provided the necessary lubrication for the valve mechanism.
3. **Engine mount replacement.** We replaced the worn engine mount on the BMW 116d. Engine mounts are responsible for securing the powertrain and reducing vibration transfer to the vehicle body. Their wear can lead to increased vibrations, discomfort inside the cabin, and added strain on other components.
4. **Identified the need to replace the torsional vibration damper.** During the service, we also determined that the vehicle would require a future replacement of the crankshaft's torsional vibration damper. This component helps dampen vibrations and ensures stable operation of the accessory drive belt. Delaying the replacement of a worn damper is not advisable, as its failure could lead to additional malfunctions and costly repairs.

src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.68cae77f16f37344:
An Audi A3 with a **1.5 TFSI engine producing 150 hp** and a DQ200 dual-clutch transmission came to our Russian car service in Belgrade for a comprehensive service. We replaced the timing belt.

As a result of the diagnostics, we also replaced the electric water pump for the cooling system. This is a separate component that requires significant service, and its replacement is not related to the timing belt. The diagnostics showed that the pump had lost efficiency and was no longer circulating the coolant properly, and we didn’t want to wait for it to affect the engine temperature. We filled it with new antifreeze after completing the work.

At the same time, we performed a minor service: replaced the engine oil and all necessary filters.

Next up was the transmission. The DQ200 is a dual-clutch system with dry clutches; we replaced the oil in the mechanical part and the operating fluid in the mechatronics. For this transmission, our recommendation is straightforward: service both the oil and mechatronics at least once every **60,000 km**. At this interval, the unit lasts longer and requires less expensive repairs.

src/content/works/audi-a3/index.md.a62fa8cdb9b6917d:
Audi A3 sa benzinskim **1.5 TFSI od 150 KS** i robotizovanom menjaču DQ200 došao je u našu automehaničarsku radionicu u Beogradu na veliki servis. Zamenili smo zupčasti remen GPR-a.

Na osnovu dijagnostike zamenili smo i električnu pumpu sistema hlađenja. To je poseban sklop, koji ima veliki servis i nije vezan za remen GPR-a. Dijagnostika je pokazala da je pumpa izgubila efikasnost i više ne pumpa rashladnu tečnost kako treba, a nismo želeli da čekamo da to utiče na temperaturni režim motora. Novi antifriz je stavljen nakon radova.

Paralelno smo uradili mali servis: motorno ulje i sve potrebne filtre.

Dalje, menjač. DQ200 je robot sa suvim kvačilima, zamenjeno je ulje u mehaničkom delu i radna tečnost u mehatronici. Preporuka za ovaj menjač je jednostavna: ulje i mehatroniku servisirati ne ređe od jednog puta svake **60 000 km**. Na takvom intervalu agregat traje duže i ređe dolazi na skupi popravak.

src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.3318a3db8067a2ea:
A BMW 118d with a N47 diesel engine and approximately **380,000 km** arrived at our car service in Belgrade. The vehicle was brought in from Denmark; the owner recently purchased it and began with comprehensive servicing and addressing the issues that had already arisen. This is the right course of action after a purchase.

We started with a complete minor service: engine oil and all filters (oil, air, cabin, and fuel). The fuel filter for the N47 is a separate matter: the condition of the fuel system directly affects how smoothly the engine runs and how long its components will last.

Next up were the suspension and brakes. We replaced the flexible boots, brake discs, and pads. On a used car with high mileage, brakes are checked first, and here the worn components had to be replaced to ensure safe driving.

We discovered a leak from the rear differential, replaced the seal, and stopped the loss of lubrication. For vehicles with such mileage, the differential, seals, and the rest of the transmission require special attention.

At 380,000 km, the list of required work cannot be completed in a single visit. We will be bringing the car back to order gradually: a full diagnosis, prioritizing tasks, and then addressing the engine, braking system, suspension, and transmission in that order. This is precisely how we advise proceeding after purchasing a used car.

Our technicians are familiar with the N47 diesels. With proper maintenance, such mileage is not a death sentence for the engine, but it is vital not to delay addressing identified issues and to avoid skipping service intervals.
src/content/works/bmw-118-d/index.md.5c386f9597970d42:
BMW 118d sa dizel motorom N47 i pređenih oko **380 000 km** stigao je u naš auto servis u Beogradu. Automobil je donet iz Danske, vlasnik ga je nedavno kupio i započeo je sa sveobuhvatnom uslugom i rešavanjem trenutnih problema. Nakon kupovine, ovo je pravi redosled postupaka.

Započeli smo sa kompletnim malim servisom: motorno ulje i svi filteri (uljni, vazdušni, kabinski i gorivni). Za N47, gorivni filter je posebna priča: od stanja gorivne sisteme zavisi koliko glatko motor radi i koliko će trajati njeni komponente.

Nakon toga, oslonac i kočnice. Zamenili smo elastične manžete, kočione diskove i pločice. Na polovnom automobilu sa velikim pređenim kilometrima, kočnice se prvo proveravaju, i ovde je bilo potrebno zameniti istrošene kako bi se mogao mirno voziti.

Pronašli smo curenje na zadnjem diferencijalu, zamenili smo semering i zaustavili gubitak podmazivanja. Automobili sa ovakvim pređenim kilometrima zahtevaju posebnu pažnju na diferencijale, zaptivke i ostalu transmisiju.

Na 380 000 km, lista radova se ne zatvara jednim posetom. Automobil ćemo postepeno doterivati: potpuno dijagnostikovanje, postavljanje prioriteta, pa redom motor, kočioni sistem, suspenzija i transmisija. Tako savetujemo da se postupa nakon kupovine polovnog automobila.

Dizeli N47 su poznati našim majstorima. Uz normalno održavanje, takav pređeni put za motor nije smrtnosna presuda, ali ne sme se odlagati otkriveno i propuštati intervali.

Danas smo u našem servisu u Beogradu obavljali servis na BMW X3. Ovo je već drugo malo održavanje koje radimo na ovoj mašini.

Ovoga puta, klijent je zamolio da pored obične zamene ulja i filtera, promenimo i ulje u 8-stepenom automatskom menjaču **ZF**.

Na ovom menjaču menjamo ulje zajedno sa karterom: filter je ugrađen u karter, i proizvodi habanja sa zagađenjem se nakupljaju tamo. Zamena samo ulja ne predstavlja potpuno servisiranje takvog automatskog menjača.

U motor je sipano ulje sa odobrenjem **BMW Longlife-04** (BMW LL-04). Za BMW odobrenje je od suštinskog značaja.

src/content/works/bmw-x3/index.md.c271fff35be3b8ee:
Today, we serviced a BMW X3 at our auto repair shop in Belgrade. This is the second minor service we have performed on this vehicle.

This time, the client requested not only the usual oil and filter change but also the oil change for the 8-speed automatic transmission **ZF**.

For this transmission, we replace the oil along with the oil pan: the filter is integrated into the pan, and contaminants accumulate there. Simply changing the oil alone does not constitute a complete service for this type of automatic transmission.

We used oil that meets the **BMW Longlife-04** (BMW LL-04) specification. Compliance with BMW standards is essential.

We also took a look at the swirl flaps in the intake. There are currently no critical issues, but we informed the client that during the next minor service, they should be removed and cleaned.

src/content/works/honda-accord/index.md.159ac38e494abc7d:
A Honda Accord with a gasoline engine came to our car service in Belgrade for scheduled maintenance.

We replaced the engine oil and the main filters: air, oil, and cabin filters. We installed new spark plugs, which are crucial for how smoothly the gasoline engine runs, how it starts, and its fuel consumption.

Additionally, we replaced the coolant and brake fluid, as these affect the engine’s operating temperature and the reliability of the brakes.

### How often should you change oil in a Honda Accord?

For the gasoline Accord, we recommend an interval of about **7,500 km**. The oil gradually loses its properties, and at this interval, the engine gets fresh oil before the old one stops functioning properly.

Besides the oil, it also makes sense to check the filters, spark plugs, coolant, brake fluid, and other consumables during servicing.
src/content/works/honda-accord/index.md.68be6ee54e7ea1a1:
Honda Accord sa benzinskim motorom došla je u naš auto servis u Beogradu na redovno tehničko održavanje.

Zamenili smo motorno ulje i osnovne filtre: vazdušni, uljni i filter za kabinu. Postavili smo nove svećice. Od njih zavisi kako radi benzinski motor, kako se pali i koliko troši.

Dodatno smo zamenili antifriz i kočionu tečnost: od njih zavise radna temperatura motora i pouzdanost kočnica.

### Koliko često menjati ulje u Honda Accord?

Za benzinski Accord preporučujemo interval od približno **7 500 km**. Ulje gubi svoja svojstva postepeno, i na tom intervalu motor uspeva da dobije sveže pre nego što staro prestane da funkcioniše kako treba.

Osim ulja, tokom održavanja ima smisla proveriti filtre, svećice, antifriz, kočionu tečnost i ostale potrošne materijale.

**Peugeot 208 1.2 PureTech. Veliki servis, mali servis i zamena ulja u menjaču u Beogradu**\
U našu auto servis na Zvezdari stigao je Peugeot 208 sa benzinskim motorom 1.2 PureTech. Automobilu je bilo potrebno sveobuhvatno tehničko održavanje, pa smo izvršili veliki servis, mali servis i zamenu ulja u menjaču.\
U okviru velikog servisa zamenili smo bregasti remen i potrebne komponente, kao i vodenu pumpu. Na motoru 1.2 PureTech pumpa se ne pokreće bregastim remenom, ali preporučujemo da je zamenite tokom velikog servisiranja. Ako odlučite da zadržite staru pumpu, svakako preporučujemo da zamenite barem jedan mali remen koji je pokreće.\
Posebnu pažnju treba posvetiti intervalima zamene bregastog remena na motorima 1.2 PureTech. Uzimajući u obzir ažurirane preporuke i karakteristike ovih motora, preporučujemo obavljanje velikog servisa svake 60.000 km, ne čekajući pojavu problema sa remenom. Tačan plan održavanja potrebno je proveriti prema konkretnoj modifikaciji motora.\
Naš auto servis poseduje svu potrebnu specijalizovanu opremu za pravilno izvođenje velikog servisa na Peugeot i Citroën motorima 1.2 PureTech. Svi radovi se obavljaju u skladu sa tehnologijom instalacije i fiksacije faza razdeljivanja gasa.\
Pored toga, izvršili smo mali servis sa zamenom motornog ulja i filtera, kao i kompletnu zamenu ulja u menjaču, koristeći ulje Valvoline.
src/content/works/peugeot-208-veliki-ser.e88be830d9eab8d7:
**Peugeot 208 1.2 PureTech. Major service, minor service, and transmission oil change in Belgrade**\
We received a Peugeot 208 with a 1.2 PureTech gasoline engine at our service center in Zvezdara. The vehicle required comprehensive maintenance, so we carried out a major service, minor service, and a transmission oil change.\
As part of the major service, we replaced the timing belt and necessary components, along with the water pump. The water pump on the 1.2 PureTech engine is not driven by the timing belt, but we recommend replacing it during major servicing. If you choose to keep the old pump, we strongly advise replacing at least the small belt that drives it.\
It is important to pay special attention to the timing belt replacement intervals for 1.2 PureTech engines. Considering the updated recommendations and specific characteristics of these engines, we suggest conducting major services every 60,000 km, rather than waiting for issues with the belt to arise. The exact schedule should be checked based on the specific engine modification.\
Our service center is equipped with all the necessary specialized tools for properly performing major services on Peugeot and Citroën 1.2 PureTech engines. All work is conducted in accordance with the technology for setting and securing the timing phases.\
Additionally, we performed a minor service, which included an oil and filter change, and fully replaced the transmission oil using Valvoline oil.

Volkswagen Golf 2017. godine sa 7-stepenom robotizovanom menjačkom kutijom **DSG DQ381** dovezen je u naš autoservis u Beogradu radi kompletnog tehničkog održavanja i rešavanja nekoliko kvarova.

Tokom održavanja zamenjena je poklopac ventila zbog curenja ulja, preporučena su goriva mlaznica, obavljeno je malo tehničko održavanje motora, zamenjeno je ulje i filter u DSG menjaču, a takođe su očišćeni kočioni čeljusti.

Posebna pažnja posvećena je DSG DQ381 menjaču. To je moderna 7-stepena transmisija sa dva kvačila, za koju je važno pravovremeno menjati ulje i filter: s vremenom ulje gubi svoja svojstva, akumuliraju se proizvodi habanja, što utiče na rad mehatronike, hidrauličkog sistema i kvačila. Redovna zamena ulja omogućava glatko prebacivanje brzina i smanjuje rizik od skupih popravki DSG-a.

Za menjač je točeno ulje **MOTUL** potrebne specifikacije, dok je u motor takođe točeno MOTUL. Kvalitet motornih i transmisijskih ulja direktno utiče na dužinu trajanja automobila.

U okviru malog tehničkog održavanja zamenjeno je motorno ulje i potrebni filteri: za turbomašine Volkswagen, pravovremena zamena ulja je posebno važna, jer podmazuje delove, odvodi toplotu i štiti turbinu od preuranjenog habanja.

Poklopac ventila je zamenjen jer je stari počeo da propušta ulje: takva curenja s vremenom se pojačavaju i dovode do zagađenja motora. Uz to, preporučeni su goriva mlaznica: hermetičnost spojeva je važna za bezbedan rad sistema za gorivo.

Takođe su očišćeni kočioni čeljusti od zagađenja i korozije: zacepljeni pokretni elementi izazivaju neujednačeno habanje kočionih obloga, pregrevanje diskova i strane zvuke prilikom kočenja.

A 2017 Volkswagen Golf with a 7-speed dual-clutch transmission **DSG DQ381** arrived at our car service in Belgrade for a comprehensive maintenance check and to address several issues.

During the service, we replaced the valve cover due to an oil leak, resealed the fuel injectors, conducted a minor engine check, changed the oil and filter in the DSG transmission, and cleaned the brake calipers.

We paid special attention to the DSG DQ381 transmission. This modern 7-speed transmission with dual clutches requires timely oil and filter changes: over time, the oil loses its properties, accumulating wear products that affect the performance of the mechatronics, hydraulic system, and clutches. Regular oil changes ensure smooth gear shifts and reduce the risk of expensive DSG repairs.

We used **MOTUL** transmission oil of the required specification for the gearbox, and we also filled the engine with MOTUL oil. The quality of both engine and transmission oil directly impacts how long the vehicle will last.

As part of the minor service, we replaced the engine oil and necessary filters: for Volkswagen's turbocharged engines, timely oil changes are especially critical as they lubricate components, dissipate heat, and protect the turbo from premature wear.

We replaced the valve cover because the old one started leaking oil: such leaks tend to worsen over time, leading to engine contamination. We also resealed the fuel injectors: the integrity of these connections is essential for the safe operation of the fuel system.

We cleaned the brake calipers from contaminants and corrosion: seized movable parts can cause uneven wear on the pads, overheating of the discs, and strange noises when braking.

Changing the oil in a **DSG DQ381** is an essential part of maintaining the transmission that should not be overlooked.

This time we performed a scheduled oil change: the client chose **MEYLE** oil, which we poured in, and we completed the rest of the necessary maintenance.

The DQ381 is a modern seven-speed DSG transmission with wet clutches, used in many Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda, and SEAT models. When serviced on time, this type of transmission can last a long time without serious issues.

The same story applies to other common DSG models, such as the DQ250 and DQ200. While their designs and specifications may differ, the condition of the oil and timely maintenance are crucial for the longevity of the transmission, the functioning of the mechatronics, and the clutches.

We recommend not only following the formal maintenance schedule but also considering the actual driving conditions. If the service history is unknown, it is definitely not advisable to run one type of oil for 100,000 to 150,000 kilometers. After every **100,000 km**, it's worthwhile to at least check when and how the transmission was serviced, and for the DQ381 and DQ250, the oil typically should be changed much sooner.

Fresh, high-quality oil maintains its necessary properties under various temperatures and loads, lubricates, and dissipates heat. This helps in postponing costly repairs.

Have you purchased a used vehicle and are unsure when the DSG DQ381, DQ250, or DQ200 was last serviced? Check the state of the transmission and its history in advance.

Zamena ulja u **DSG DQ381** je deo održavanja menjača koji ne treba zanemariti.

Ovog puta smo obavili redovnu zamenu: klijent je odabrao ulje **MEYLE**, sipali smo ga i izvršili ostalo potrebno održavanje.

DQ381 je savremeni sedmostepeni robotizovani menjač DSG sa mokrim spojkama, koji se koristi u mnogim Volkswagen, Audi, Škoda i SEAT vozilima. Ako se redovno održava, takav menjač traje dugo i bez ozbiljnih problema.

Sa drugim uobičajenim DSG menjačima, DQ250 i DQ200, situacija je ista. Njihova konstrukcija i propisi se razlikuju, ali stanje ulja i pravovremeno održavanje direktno utiču na životni vek menjača, rad mehatronike i spojki.

Preporučujemo da se ne oslanjate samo na formalne propise, već i na stvarne uslove eksploatacije. Ako ne znate istoriju održavanja, sigurno nije pametno voziti na istom ulju 100-150 hiljada kilometara. Svakih **100 000 km** ima smisla proveriti kada i kako je menjač servisiran, a za DQ381 i DQ250 ulje obično treba menjati znatno ranije.

Sveže, kvalitetno ulje održava potrebna svojstva pri različitim temperaturama i opterećenjima, podmazuje i odvodi toplotu. Zbog toga se skupi popravak odlaže.

Kupili ste polovno vozilo i ne znate kada je poslednji put servisiran DSG DQ381, DQ250 ili DQ200? Proverite stanje menjača i njegovu istoriju unapred.
